scope: Proposition 8.1 (Dual energy estimate) of the manuscript “The first lattice correction to Bloch's law” (preprints/The-first-lattice-correction-to-Blochs-law-October-5-2026/first-lattice-correction-bloch-law.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 271 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4c19762cfd46fbb0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix S, and use the scales in (4.8). Suppose that B50R∗ (x) lies in the interior of the finite cube and that no point of E lies above this ball. Let G be the good event of Proposition 4.4, and let µ+, µ− be the terminal residuals in (6.11). There are nonnegative measurable functions X+, X− of the exposure and a deterministic rapidly small function ρ(β) such that, on G, |⟨µd, y⟩| ≤ Xd √ ey + C0ρ(β), d ∈ {+, −}, (8.1) for every real cut vector y that vanishes on the cut killing slots and satisfies ∥y∥∞ ≤ C0. The functions Xd do not depend on y or C0, and EP h 1G(X2 + + X2 −) i = o(β−5/2 ). (8.2) All estimates are uniform over the finite cubes, deterministic pin sets, and injection slots satisfying the stated assumptions.
